## Checklist

### Ethical Safeguards
- [ ] Changes preserve the ethical use agreement
- [ ] Educational content maintained (WHAT/WHY before HOW)
- [ ] No new identified risks introduced
- [ ] Principle Zero considered ("Do no harm, allow no harm")

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows existing patterns
- [ ] Comments explain the WHY, not the WHAT
- [ ] No unnecessary complexity added

### Testing
- [ ] Generator runs without errors
- [ ] Generated files are valid
- [ ] Ethical safeguards function correctly

### Documentation
- [ ] README updated (if needed)
- [ ] CLAUDE.md updated (if needed)
- [ ] Version updated (if applicable)
